Almond Butter Cookies
By: yin
Published: Friday, September 16, 2011 - 8:00pm

Ingredients




INGREDIENTS A
180g butter
90g castor sugar
1/8 tsp salt
½ tsp Vanilla essence
INGREDIENTS B
(sifted together)
135g plain flour, sifted
90g rice flour, sifted
90g ground almond
DECORATION
50g almond flakes on top as decoration

Preparation

1 Cream butter and castor sugar till light and fluffy, add salt, vanilla and mix well. 2 Fold in B: plain flour, rice flour and mix into soft dough. 3 Roll dough between 2 sheets of plastic into 3mm thick. 4 Using cookies cutter cut into desired shape 5 Arrange cookies onto a greased baking tray. 6 Decorate top with almond flake. (I skipped this) 7 Bake in a pre-heated oven at 180 degrees C for 15-20 minutes, till lightly brown. 8 Remove and cool before storing into air-tight container.

About

I found this cookies were overpowered by the buttery flavor. To me it tasted more like butter cookies than almond cookies. Hence, I am renaming this recipe to Almond Butter Cookies. Having said that, the cookies are tasty to eat, not too sweet and it was really crunchy on the outside but soft from the inside.
